copy.title: Your high sensitivity first manifests as "early warning" rather than collapse on the spot.
copy.body: The anxiety-related facets are significantly higher than the domain mean, which shows that the first thing you are pulled up is usually not the exposure of emotions, but the early warning of risks, mistakes, and uncertainties.
copy.why_it_matters: It reminds you to treat warnings as signals instead of attributing yourself to "thinking too much."

copy.title: Reports of low mood stand out in this profile.
copy.body: This report places N3 above overall Neuroticism (N). Review specific experiences of low mood, discouragement, or negative self-evaluation. The difference in position is not a difference in how often experiences occur, and it does not establish chronic stress as their cause.
copy.why_it_matters: Duration, context, and support needs require your own history, rather than a predicted course from this score.

copy.title: Reports of giving in to urges stand out within this profile.
copy.body: This report places N5 above overall Neuroticism (N). Review specific examples of overindulgence or difficulty resisting temptation. Do not treat the difference in position as a difference in frequency or use it to infer withdrawal under pressure.
copy.why_it_matters: Identifying the particular urge, context, and consequences can help you decide whether any change is useful.

copy.title: You are not a typical "publicly shy sensitive" person.
copy.body: Although domain N is high, the self-awareness-related facets are significantly low, indicating that your high sensitivity is not mainly manifested in being particularly withdrawn in front of others.
copy.why_it_matters: This contrast can explain: You may still appear normal externally, but you have already incurred a lot of costs internally.

copy.title: Coping difficulty sits below overall Neuroticism in this result.
copy.body: This report places N6 below overall Neuroticism (N). Understand coping difficulties through actual experiences; the difference in position does not predict hidden overload or a later collapse.
copy.why_it_matters: Ask about actual strain and support needs instead of inferring them from outward composure.
